successors.name: Naqada culture
successors.text: El-Badari "between Matmar and Qau": the area "stretches for 30 km (19 mi) along the east bank of the Nile", "approximately 200 km (120 mi) northwest of present-day Luxor"; Mostagedda, Deir Tasa…

ledger.x: 4400 BCE: the Badarian farmers of the Asyut reach, the first Predynastic culture of Upper Egypt.
4000 BCE: the Badarian becomes the Amratian, Naqada I.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: one radius on the Nile around the Badari cemeteries, never a frontier.
